row.team_price_text: Lite: $23/mo (monthly list price) + Team Members $11/mo per user
row.evidence: FreshBooks sells Lite, Plus, Premium and Select with Team Members at $11/mo per user and no SSO or SCIM on any plan; sign-in options are email/password with 2FA or "Sign in with Apple or Sign in with Google".
row.notes: No SCIM by absence, and no SAML/OIDC SSO with a customer IdP (only social sign-in with Apple or Google, which does not count). Pricing is a flat monthly price per account (list Lite $23, Plus $43, Premium $70 per month; promos of $1/mo or 80% off shown) plus the Team Members add-on at $11/mo per user, so per-user fields are null; a Yearly toggle (extra 10% off) exists but the default render shows monthly prices. Select is contact sales. Team members are invited and removed by hand (set to Unassigned or delete); deleting does not free the paid seat until the account is downgraded. The API (OAuth2) can only read team members (scope user:teams:read). Okta's FreshBooks app is SWA (password vaulting) only. Not listed in the Entra gallery, Google SAML catalogue or JumpCloud's SSO list.

plans.name: Lite
plans.price_text: $23/month (list; promo $1/mo for first year) + Team Members $11/mo per user
plans.notes: Flat account price; extra users are the Team Members add-on.

plans.name: Select
plans.price_text: Contact sales (Let's Talk); 2 Team Member accounts included

scim.notes: No SCIM documented on the pricing page, help centre, API reference or IdP catalogues.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event list covers invoices, clients, expenses, payments, projects, time entries and similar; no team-member events seen.

rate_limits.text: No daily cap; short-burst rate limiting; list methods return at most 100 results.

limitations.text: Team members can only be read through the API; inviting, role changes and removal are done in the app.
Deleting a team member does not remove the paid seat until the account is downgraded.

user_api.notes: available=false: the API exposes read-only team-member data, not user management.

okta.notes: OIN Freshbooks app (rendered) checks SWA only; no SAML, OIDC or SCIM.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (freshbooks-tutorial returns 404).

google.notes: Not in Google's pre-integrated SAML catalogue or autoprovisioning list.

jumpcloud.notes: Not in JumpCloud's SSO application guide list.
